t: Russian Armed Forces Hit 5 Ukrainian Data Centers Used to Support Kiev's Army in October
d: MOSCOW, (Sputnik) - In October, the Russian Armed Forces struck five Ukrainian data centers used to support the Ukrainian force, according to Sputnik's calculations based on reports from the Russian Defense Ministry.
